(1) PR #555: data/enrich_gfs.sh runs the new data/add_evapduct.py right after add_sst.py, and ops/bake-weatherx.sh adds evapduct to OPTIONAL_GFS_VARS (data/test_add_evapduct.py is its test). enrich_gfs.sh runs in two lanes: the publish-gfs component job (publish-current-model-production.yml -> ops/bake-model-component.sh) and the whole bake job (bake.yml -> ops/bake-weatherx.sh); core (gfs) (collect-core-model.yml -> data/bake_model_inputs.py -> data/fetch.py) does not run it. The step reads the run's baked rh, wind and sst textures (sst alpha is the sea mask), fetches TMP:2 m above ground and TMP:surface for every lead as two bounded byte ranges from the keyless NODD bucket noaa-gfs-bdp-pds.s3.amazonaws.com (146 ranges, about 80 MB per run, 4 workers), checks each GRIB message's identity, and writes evapduct/{i}.png (73 gray+alpha frames, 0-40 m, about 32 MB per run measured on 2026100918). It needs no new env, variable, secret or package: numpy, pillow, requests and eccodes are already pinned in data/requirements.txt and add_sst.py imports eccodes in the same step. Any failure (rh/wind/sst missing, no open-water cells, a frame median outside 4-25 m, more than 25% capped or zero cells, a NODD or GRIB identity error) is a logged non-fatal [enrich] FAIL that leaves evapduct out of that run. The whole bake's freshness gate treats a missing evapduct as optional; the component job's ops/platform/validate-model-component.py compare_live (unchanged) is strict: once a published GFS component carries evapduct, a later GFS candidate without it is refused (candidate drops live variables) and the previous run stays live, so this pin is fix-forward only for GFS (moving back to a source without the producer would withhold every GFS component publish). (2) PR #515: data/carry_static_addons.py, the carry step of enrich_gfs.sh in the same two lanes: a carried GEOS-CF frame now removes the source-stale retirement receipt add_so2.py or add_geoscf.py wrote for that field (the 10-08 GFS component refusal: retirement receipts contradict present variables co, o3surf, so2), and a carried field holding any other kind of receipt fails that step before a frame is copied.
